test_read_pytables_hdf5_complete: test reading a PyTables HDF5 file written by plain PyTables using pd.read_hdf with the complete dataset
test_read_pytables_hdf5_with_start: test reading a PyTables HDF5 file with a start parameter to slice rows from pd.read_hdf
test_read_pytables_hdf5_with_stop: test reading a PyTables HDF5 file with a stop parameter to slice rows up to a limit from pd.read_hdf
test_read_pytables_hdf5_with_startstop: test reading a PyTables HDF5 file with both start and stop parameters to slice a row range from pd.read_hdf
test_legacy_hdf5_files: test reading legacy HDF5 storage files created by older pandas versions for backward compatibility
